# Context
- Cluster `kestrel-prod-eu2`, namespace `ingest`, work through `kubectl` [m0][m4]. Paging threshold: page the data platform lead at 2 million lag [m9]. The runbook's "page SRE secondary at 5 million" is a legacy note [m91]. The user wants every cluster-changing command shown to them before it runs [m4].

Migration number must be 0042 with the name `0042_ledger_idempotency_unique.sql`, and the index must be built with `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` (table has about 80M rows) [m220]. Commit messages are imperative with no ticket prefix; target branch `release/2026.11`, not `main` [m314]. Do not change values while converting configs; keep comments; do not stop to ask between services [m321].

- Kestrel incident: lag was 310k at 14:20 and 780k at 14:50 [m6][m12]. Pods were healthy, CPU 35% [m14]. Commit 3f9a2c1 "tune poll for memory" in 8.14.0 changed `max.poll.records` from 500 to 50 [m17][m18].

The user asked to keep the default at 500 in `deploy/consumer/values.yaml` with a comment pointing to #inc-4417 [m142]. I read that file (its current value is `maxPollRecords: 50`) [m171][m172], but I have not edited it yet. The PR has not been opened.

  - Edited `settle_batch` to insert with `on_conflict="nothing"` inside `tx()` and fall back to `find_by_idempotency_key(idempotency_key, conn=conn)` [m243]. I have not verified that `insert_entry` supports that keyword beyond reading `ledger.py` [m249][m250].
  - 50 runs with `-n 4` passed [m257][m258]. Full `pytest -n 4 payments/` had one failure, `test_refund_rounding` (PAY-2291) [m267][m274].
  - The user asked to raise `RETRY_BACKOFF_MS` from 200 to 350, then to 500 [m275][m297]. Current value in `payments/core/settlement.py` is 500 [m304]. The only test that reads it asserts `>= 200`, so it still passes [m289].

- Config migration (`services/`, 12 services: billing, catalog, exports, gateway, identity, inventory, notifications, pricing, reporting, search, shipping, webhooks) [m326][m327]:
  - Done and YAML deleted (git rm): billing [m334][m338][m346]; catalog [m354][m358][m368]; exports, after fixing `cutoff` to quoted "2026-01-31" because a bare date changed its type [m388][m389][m397]; gateway [m407][m411][m419]; identity, after adding `OPTIONAL_KEYS` handling for `issuer_override: null` [m427][m431][m439][m440][m450]; notifications [m475][m479][m487]; reporting [m510][m514][m522].

  - Not yet done: shipping, webhooks.

- Use `set env` for the immediate fix instead of rolling back, because of the CVE fix [m21][m109][m110].
